description: Execute SQL queries on database connections retrieved from Nacos configuration service

database_connection.info: Select a database connection from the available connections

sql_query.info: Enter your SQL query to execute

safe_mode.info: When enabled, blocks dangerous SQL operations (DROP, DELETE, UPDATE, INSERT, etc.)

warnings.no_results: Query executed successfully but returned no results

errors.connection_not_found: Database connection '{name}' not found in configuration
errors.sqlalchemy_required: SQLAlchemy is required. Please install it with: pip install sqlalchemy
errors.dangerous_operation: Query blocked by safe mode: contains '{keyword}' operation

enable_transaction.info: Whether to use database transactions for data consistency.

field_mappings.info: Optional field transformations and default values.

incremental_offset_seconds.info: Time offset for incremental data extraction.

incremental_timestamp_init.info: Initial timestamp for incremental data extraction (e.g., 2024-01-01 00:00:00).

max_records.info: Maximum number of records to fetch (0 for no limit).

page_size.info: Number of records per page when using pagination.

table_name.info: Name of the database table to query.

use_pagination.info: Whether to fetch data in pages to reduce memory usage.
